summary: Strengthen lease, maintenance, cost, and property KPI controls with practical exercises. Explore the five-day advanced property management course.
lede: Advanced property management coordinates leases, building services, maintenance, budgets, and asset performance. Designed for property, facilities, and asset operations professionals, the course addresses practical control of buildings and portfolios through lease and arrears analysis, lifecycle cost assessment and maintenance prioritisation, and vendor scorecards and property KPI reporting.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who already work with buildings, leases, facilities, or property portfolios and want stronger operational controls. It is designed for roles responsible for measurable property outcomes.
modules: Property KPI Reporting and Action Plans
prerequisites: Working experience in property, facilities, lease, or building operations is recommended. You should be comfortable reviewing basic property records and operating information. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with Excel access for spreadsheet exercises.
